title: deliver progress tokens
description: Token fixture <case>.tokens.json next to <case>.jsonl (test/skills/delivery/fixtures/progress-events/): what a display shows after each event of the file. One entry per complete line, in file order; an incomplete last line has no entry. Unknown event types and fields change nothing, so their entry repeats the one before. A run that turns abandoned (no run.finished, ADR 0001 rule) ends with one more entry without seq, `abandoned: true`, all tokens cleared and the agent released. The source of the tokens is `deliver` (TTL one hour), of the agent state `deliver-loop` with agent `deliver`. The same event file always yields the same entries.

seq.description: seq of the event this entry follows

abandoned.description: the run turned abandoned after its last event; only as the final entry

tokens.description: The five tokens after the event; null: not set on the pane (never set, or cleared).

deliver_step.description: [<n>/<total> ]<step>[: <text>] of the last step.finished, cut at 80 characters

deliver_pr.description: #<pr> from the prUrl of the last step.finished that had one

agent.description: Agent state of the pane after the event: working (issue.started), blocked (attention paused or blocked), released (run.finished, after idle or blocked); null: never reported.

pane.description: host.herdrPane of run.started, the pane the tokens and the state are set on; null without one
